# Game Idea: Lava Escape

- Control a small avatar that moves horizontally at the bottom of the canvas.
- Lava rises from the bottom, accelerating over time.
- Collect floating air bubbles to extend your survival time.
- **Lose condition:** touching the lava or running out of air ends the game.

1: // Simple Lava Escape game with enhanced graphics
2: // Canvas with id="game" assumed in HTML
3: (() => {
4:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
5:   if (!canvas) return;
6:   // Audio setup
7:   const audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
8:   function playTone(freq, duration) {
9:     const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
10:     const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
11:     osc.frequency.value = freq;
12:     osc.type = 'sine';
13:     osc.connect(gain);
14:     gain.connect(audioCtx.destination);
15:     gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.001, audioCtx.currentTime);
16:     gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.2, audioCtx.currentTime + 0.01);
17:     osc.start();
18:     gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, audioCtx.currentTime + duration);
19:     osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + duration);
20:   }
21:   // Ensure audio context resumes after first interaction
22:   const resumeAudio = () => { if (audioCtx.state === 'suspended') audioCtx.resume(); };
23:   window.addEventListener('keydown', resumeAudio, {once: true});
24:   window.addEventListener('click', resumeAudio, {once: true});
25:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
26:   const width = canvas.width;
27:   const height = canvas.height;
28: 
29:   // Game state
30:   const player = { x: width / 2, y: height - 30, w: 20, h: 20, speed: 4 };
31:   let lavaY = height; // starts off-screen bottom
32:   let lavaSpeed = 0.3;
33:   let air = 10; // seconds of air
34:   const bubbles = [];
35:   let lastBubble = 0;
36: 
37:   // Input handling
38:   const keys = {};
39:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => (keys[e.key] = true));
40:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e => (keys[e.key] = false));
41: 
42:   function spawnBubble() {
43:     const radius = 8;
44:     const x = Math.random() * (width - radius * 2) + radius;
45:     const y = Math.random() * (lavaY - 100) + 50; // stay above lava
46:     bubbles.push({ x, y, radius, collected: false });
47:   }
48: 
49:   function update(dt) {
50:     // Player movement
51:     if (keys.ArrowLeft) player.x -= player.speed;
52:     if (keys.ArrowRight) player.x += player.speed;
53:     player.x = Math.max(0, Math.min(width - player.w, player.x));
54: 
55:     // Lava rise
56:     lavaY -= lavaSpeed * dt;
57:     lavaSpeed += 0.00002 * dt; // accelerate
58: 
59:     // Air consumption
60:     air -= dt / 1000;
61: 
62:     // Bubble spawning
63:     if (performance.now() - lastBubble > 2000) {
64:       spawnBubble();
65:       lastBubble = performance.now();
66:     }
67:     // Check bubble collection
68:     for (const b of bubbles) {
69:       if (!b.collected) {
70:         const dx = b.x - (player.x + player.w / 2);
71:         const dy = b.y - (player.y + player.h / 2);
72:         const dist = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
73:         if (dist < b.radius + Math.max(player.w, player.h) / 2) {
74:           b.collected = true;
75:           air += 3; // add 3 seconds
76:           playTone(600, 0.1); // bubble collect sound
77:         }
78:       }
79:     }
80:   }
81: 
82:   function draw() {
83:     // Background gradient (dark sky)
84:     const bgGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, height);
85:     bgGrad.addColorStop(0, '#1a001a');
86:     bgGrad.addColorStop(1, '#330033');
87:     ctx.fillStyle = bgGrad;
88:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
89: 
90:     // Lava gradient (glowing bottom)
91:     const lavaGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, lavaY, 0, height);
92:     lavaGrad.addColorStop(0, '#ff4500');
93:     lavaGrad.addColorStop(1, '#8b0000');
94:     ctx.fillStyle = lavaGrad;
95:     ctx.fillRect(0, lavaY, width, height - lavaY);
96:     // Add subtle lava glow
97:     ctx.shadowColor = 'rgba(255,69,0,0.6)';
98:     ctx.shadowBlur = 10;
99:     ctx.fillRect(0, lavaY, width, height - lavaY);
100:     ctx.shadowBlur = 0; // reset
101: 
102:     // Player – circular avatar with gradient
103:     const playerGrad = ctx.createRadialGradient(
104:       player.x + player.w / 2,
105:       player.y + player.h / 2,
106:       2,
107:       player.x + player.w / 2,
108:       player.y + player.h / 2,
109:       player.w
110:     );
111:     playerGrad.addColorStop(0, '#00ffff');
112:     playerGrad.addColorStop(1, '#0066ff');
113:     ctx.fillStyle = playerGrad;
114:     ctx.beginPath();
115:     ctx.arc(player.x + player.w / 2, player.y + player.h / 2, player.w / 2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
116:     ctx.fill();
117: 
118:     // Bubbles – light radial gradient with slight glow
119:     for (const b of bubbles) {
120:       if (!b.collected) {
121:         const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(b.x, b.y, 0, b.x, b.y, b.radius);
122:         grad.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(173,216,230,0.9)');
123:         grad.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(173,216,230,0.2)');
124:         ctx.fillStyle = grad;
125:         ctx.shadowColor = 'rgba(173,216,230,0.5)';
126:         ctx.shadowBlur = 6;
127:         ctx.beginPath();
128:         ctx.arc(b.x, b.y, b.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
129:         ctx.fill();
130:         ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
131:       }
132:     }
133: 
134:     // HUD – bright text with subtle shadow
135:     ctx.fillStyle = 'white';
136:     ctx.shadowColor = 'black';
137:     ctx.shadowBlur = 4;
138:     ctx.font = '16px sans-serif';
139:     ctx.fillText(`Air: ${air.toFixed(1)}s`, 10, 20);
140:     ctx.shadowBlur = 0; // reset for future draws
141:   }
142: 
143:   // Audio setup
144:   const audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
145:   function playTone(freq, duration) {
146:     const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
147:     const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
148:     osc.frequency.value = freq;
149:     osc.type = 'sine';
150:     osc.connect(gain);
151:     gain.connect(audioCtx.destination);
152:     gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.001, audioCtx.currentTime);
153:     gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.2, audioCtx.currentTime + 0.01);
154:     osc.start();
155:     gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, audioCtx.currentTime + duration);
156:     osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + duration);
157:   }
158:   // Background lava rumble loop
159:   let rumbleInterval = setInterval(() => playTone(150, 0.2), 2000);
160: 
161:   let last = performance.now();
162:   function loop() {
163:     const now = performance.now();
164:     const dt = now - last;
165:     last = now;
166:     update(dt);
167:     draw();
168:     // Lose condition
169:     if (air <= 0 || lavaY <= player.y + player.h) {
170:       // Stop background rumble
171:       clearInterval(rumbleInterval);
172:       // Play game over sound
173:       playTone(200, 0.5);
174:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.7)';
175:       ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
176:       ctx.fillStyle = 'white';
177:       ctx.font = '24px sans-serif';
178:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', width / 2 - 60, height / 2);
179:     } else {
180:       requestAnimationFrame(loop);
181:     }
182:   }
183:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
184: })();
